title: Plonk zone set
description: A layout of fractional rectangles over one screen's visible area. Screen-agnostic: the same set is assigned to any monitor and stretches to it.

name.description: What the set is called in the app, the menu and get_state. Unique across this folder and not one of the built-ins.

description.description: One line on what the layout is for, and which zone is meant to hold what.

screen.description: The shape of monitor this was drawn for. Advisory: any set works on any screen, but a 25% column is a sidebar on an ultrawide and a sliver on a laptop.

author.description: GitHub handle, with the at sign.

zones.description: The zones, in the order they are numbered: zone 1 is the first, and it is the one CTRL+OPT+1 fills.
